verdict_vs_market.quote: It's a fair opening offer, but it's probably not enough to justify leaving a job you like

verdict_vs_current.quote: What I don't know: your actual Meta pay. That matters more than any market data.

recommendation.quote: Don't accept this offer as written. Negotiate firmly, and be ready to walk away.

equity_grounding.quote: It brings years 1–2 to about $740K a year, and years 3–4 to roughly what the current offer pays on average.

uses_public_incumbent_benchmark.quote: Levels.fyi shows a median of about $607K for a Google L6 Product Manager.

refresh_valued_at.quote: Price the offer on what's guaranteed.

walkaway_tied_to.quote: the final offer's average guaranteed yearly pay over four years should beat your Meta trajectory by a real margin

unsupported_claims.claim: Google's standard vesting schedule is 33/33/22/12 monthly with no cliff
unsupported_claims.quote: Its usual new-hire schedule is 33% / 33% / 22% / 12%, vesting monthly with no cliff.

unsupported_claims.claim: Sign-on sits in a separate budget and can be raised when other components are firm
unsupported_claims.quote: Sign-on sits in a separate budget from your base and GSU negotiation, so it can often be raised even when other parts are "firm."

unsupported_claims.claim: Meta cut equity refreshers by 10% in 2025 and 5% in 2026
unsupported_claims.quote: Meta employees got about 5% less equity in 2026 refreshers, after roughly a 10% cut in 2025.

ask_focus.quote: Ask for all three of these together in one counter:

specific_ask_without_gap.quote: Specifically, a $260K base, a $1.4M GSU grant, and a $[X]K sign-on to cover the Meta equity and bonus I'd forfeit.

rsu_annualized.quote: Your offer averages $552K over four years, which is a bit below the median.

year1_vs_recurring.quote: Add up the Meta stock you'd forfeit in the next ~6 months plus any bonus you'd give up by leaving before payout.

forfeiture_as_loss.quote: You'll likely give up unvested Meta stock and part of a bonus when you leave, and Google usually covers that with a sign-on.
